name: Geode
author: Erin Carter
description: A druzy crystal bed wall to wall: small angular Voronoi facets in cold dim mineral tones, the faintest line tracing each edge. Individual facets fire sharp specular glints on independent timers — a fast attack, a slow afterglow — only a handful alive at once, scattered like moonlight on quartz.

params.label: Spark rate
params.effect: How often facets fire; low gives rare lone diamond flashes with long quiet stretches, high keeps a continuous shimmer alive across the bed.

params.label: Facet size
params.effect: Approximate crystal facet size in CSS px; small gives fine druzy sparkle, large gives bold cathedral-crystal slabs.

params.label: Glint
params.effect: Peak brightness and sharpness of each specular flash; low is a damp mineral sheen, high a hard diamond flash.

params.label: Afterglow
params.effect: Relative decay length of each flash; low makes snap glints that vanish at once, high leaves facets cooling visibly for seconds after they fire.
